examples.text: Стари́к смея́лся, сия́л и, ви́димо, с удово́льствием слу́шал дья́кона, то́чно рад был, что на э́том све́те и кро́ме него́ есть ещё гре́шные лю́ди.
examples.translation: The old man laughed, beamed, and evidently listened with pleasure to the deacon as though he were glad there were other sinful persons in this world besides himself.
examples.english: The old man laughed, beamed, and evidently listened with pleasure to the deacon as though he were glad there were other sinful persons in this world besides himself.

examples.text: I take a whiff of the most sincerely sinful cookies in the history of the world. It’s a recipe I saw in People magazine once at the dentist's office, and Dr. Segal would not approve of its ingredients (or maybe she would, in the interest of keeping her business afloat).
